quest.title: Operation Downpour Simulation
quest.description: In a corner of the Court of Fontaine, Turenna and Enghiene, members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, have set up a new tabletop wargame. The stage is set for you to show off your tactical brilliance...

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the Maison Gardiennage

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: #Just as we set our strategy and picked our script, the Proto-Boss, {NICKNAME}, makes a grand entrance!

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: Seriously? You believe in that old saying?

dialogues.speaker: Enghiene
dialogues.text: "Sensing the heat of impending battle, the Proto-Boss will appear like a bullet from the dark — to commandeer their troops with ruthless efficiency..."

choices.text: Seems like I showed up right on cue.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I see! You mean to say that the velocity of our musket rounds can still be improved... I feel the same way.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: #Put a sock in it, Turenna! We got {NICKNAME} to come all this way, so let's get down to business!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Fair enough. Musket talk comes later, then. Now, Proto-Boss, I'm sure you're in top form, ready to lead your troops at any time, right?

choices.text: Is this about a new tabletop wargame?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Right you are! The rules and layout have been updated according to scenarios faced by the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Which is to say that this current iteration is more challenging. We've prepared a number of special scenarios, including some contributions from the Patrol's elites.

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: Some scenarios are seriously brain-boggling... So why don't you lead us by example, Proto-Boss?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Of course, you'll be handsomely compensated for your help. Go play, get paid — two birds with one stone!

choices.text: Time to strut my stuff, then!

response.speaker: Enghiene
response.text: #Just you watch, Turenna. No matter how good {NICKNAME} is, I'm sure the third Assault Scenario will be a real toughie...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: #Nonsense! There's no way {M#he'll}{F#she'll} get stuck on that. Maybe you're just getting rusty, Drillmaster.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Let's bet on it, Drillmaster! I wager... Some of Captain Chevreuse's limited-edition ammunition!

choices.text: Getting paid to play? That's the dream.
Umm, I don't quite get it...

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Simply put, after we returned from that cooperative wargame in Liyue, we adapted it to suit the Special Patrol's current needs.

choices.text: More like lightning than a bullet, no?
